tasks.final_text: My favorite food is probably bean and cheese burritos. There's nothing quite like going to somewhere like Taco Bell at 2 AM when the roads are all silent and not a single bird is chirping, walk into a warm and welcoming restaurant, and eat a bite of delicious goodness, served hot and fresh and full of flavor.

The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka. It is locatetd in the oldest remaining Dutch building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.
